purpose: Record A's scientific audit reference and C's evidence/ResearchRecord handoff against B20a execution facts without signing A or C scope or relabelling science.

run_spec_ref.started_at_binding_rule: Set once at the first C24a-approved submit. Every phase (da-submit, da-evidence, aggregate) reads this same value; the readiness attempt does not start the science clock.
run_spec_ref.shared_started_at_rule: Every phase (da-submit, da-evidence, aggregate) reads this same value. B20b and C T-35 must not reset it or start a second science clock.
run_spec_ref.queue_accounting: Local queue wait is 0s and is included in the same cumulative window. If LSF were selected, queue wait would count against science_deadline_seconds; it does not get a separate budget.
run_spec_ref.inflight_stop_policy: At science_deadline_seconds stop starting new science steps. A still-running step is either stopped with confirmed termination or retained by reference and reconciled in the export window; it is never reported complete.
run_spec_ref.evidence_phase_rule: At science_deadline_seconds only new expensive science steps stop. The export (900s) and aggregate (120s) windows are judged by actual completion; the evidence phase is not failed solely because the science clock reached 13380s.

counters.compute_owner: none (da-submit stopped before dispatch: C24a absent)

b_execution_facts.facts_only_rule: B records execution/release/attempt/manifest/budget facts only. B does not assign a scientific status and does not relabel an execution terminal state as claim support.

a_audit_ref.expected_schema: no standalone JSON Schema declared; identified by handoff_id=H4, handoff_version=1 (contract_set=acp2.science, contract_set_version=1)
a_audit_ref.rule: A signs the scientific conclusion. B attaches the reference and the observed gap; B does not sign or replace A scope.

c_t35_ref.rule: C T-35 consumes B20a-exec and A-17..A-19 and does not wait for B20b. B20b waits for C T-35. C may add evidence/ResearchRecord fields, but may not override B job_id/attempt/release_id/submission_id/manifest_generation/task facts.

propositions.statement: The real B20a-exec transition-state candidate has exactly one significant imaginary frequency with a mapped native mode.
propositions.h4_row_gap: B20a-exec has not published the authorized TS optimize/frequency step receipts and artifacts: no real magnitude/mode record, snapshot digest, attempt or release exists. A constructed validator PASS is not real evidence.
propositions.why: A real B20a-exec TS optimize/frequency artifact is required; no magnitude/mode record, snapshot digest, attempt or release exists.

propositions.statement: Real forward and reverse IRC both complete and connect the declared reactant/product endpoints for the same TS identity.
propositions.h4_row_gap: B20a-exec has not published the authorized forward/reverse IRC step receipts and artifacts: no real direction results, native step counts, terminal states or snapshot digest exist.
propositions.why: A real B20a-exec bidirectional IRC artifact is required; no forward/reverse result, direction label, native step count or terminal state exists.

propositions.statement: The real IRC endpoint geometries and bond-topology mapping prove the declared reactant-to-product path under stable atom order.
propositions.h4_row_gap: B20a-exec has not published the authorized endpoint geometries or the mapped product structure; no real atom-order-stable endpoint mapping exists.
propositions.why: A real B20a-exec endpoint artifact and mapped product structure are required; no atom-order-stable endpoint mapping exists.

propositions.statement: The real electronic activation energy is comparable under the frozen method, basis, electronic state, temperature, pressure and standard state with an explicit unit.
propositions.h4_row_gap: B20a-exec has not published authorized energy/thermochemistry artifacts; additionally B18 must reconcile the frozen 1_bar_ideal_gas standard state with the ThermochemistryOptions 1atm/1M lexicon before a real run.
propositions.why: A real B20a-exec energy artifact is required; additionally B18 must reconcile the frozen 1_bar_ideal_gas standard state with the ThermochemistryOptions 1atm/1M lexicon.

propositions.statement: The real free-energy activation barrier is comparable under the frozen thermochemistry conditions, separate from the electronic barrier claim.
propositions.h4_row_gap: B20a-exec has not published authorized energy/thermochemistry artifacts; additionally B18 must reconcile the frozen 1_bar_ideal_gas standard state with the ThermochemistryOptions 1atm/1M lexicon before a real run.
propositions.why: No real B20a-exec thermochemistry artifact exists; the frozen standard-state lexicon reconciliation is still pending.

propositions.statement: A separate declared search run generates and accepts at least one candidate under declared input criteria, candidate source/count, generation steps, filtering/rejection reasons, validator and success criteria.
propositions.h4_row_gap: B20a-search has not published its separate search evidence row: no input category, candidate source/count, generation steps, rejection reasons, validators or success criteria exist. A control-loop or known-candidate PASS is explicitly not search evidence.
propositions.why: Search was not declared: no input class, TS seed, candidate source/count, generation steps, rejection reasons, validator or success criteria. A known-candidate chain is explicitly not search evidence.

propositions.statement: A TS artifact with no frequency evidence is reported inconclusive (frequency_not_computed), never supported and never refuted.
propositions.why: Correctly reporting an absent frequency is a PASS for honesty only. It does not supply the missing real frequency evidence and cannot satisfy H4-01, H4-02, H4-03 or H4-04.

claim_status.reason: No authorized execution artifact exists; no scientific claim was evaluated.

h4_gate.reason: H4 requires real positive TS/IRC/comparable-energy rows and the separate B20a-search row; none exist.

result_vs_claim.rule: The scenario result answers whether the required operation completed. claim_status answers whether the scientific proposition is supported. h4_gate answers whether the H4 positive evidence set is complete. None implies either of the others.

negative_case_rule.rule: A correctly-inconclusive negative case may PASS its own scenario while the required positive TS/IRC/comparable-energy gate stays unsatisfied.

one_imaginary_frequency_not_connectivity.rule: A single imaginary frequency identifies a first-order-saddle candidate only. It never proves IRC connectivity.
irc_connectivity_requires: endpoint geometries mapped under stable atom order
same TS identity for both directions

c_cannot_overwrite_b_task_truth.rule: C's ResearchRecord may reference evidence and record a research decision, but it must not overwrite B's persisted task/execution truth.

validation.assertion: While B20a-exec is absent there are zero supported propositions, and every supported proposition would require a real source artifact and digest.
